workflow.title: workflow *
workflow.description: Name of the workflow to run (`PRE_MYCOSNP` for Pre-MycoSNP workflow | `NFCORE_MYCOSNP` for main MycoSNP workflow). [default: NFCORE_MYCOSNP]

assembler.title: assembler
assembler.description: Assembler to use with Shovill. Options are 'skesa', 'velvet', 'megahit', 'spades' [default: skesa].

shovill_depth.title: shovill_depth
shovill_depth.description: Downsample FASTQ files to this depth before assembly [default: 70]

genome_size.title: genome_size
genome_size.description: The approx. genome size of the sample, used by Shovill. Will be automatically determined if left blank.

min_contig_cov.title: min_contig_cov
min_contig_cov.description: Minimum contig depth of coverage for it to be retained in the assembly, used by Shovill [default: 10]

min_contig_len.title: min_contig_len
min_contig_len.description: Minimum contig length for it to be retained in the assembly, used by Shovill [default: 300]

positions.title: positions
positions.description: FKS1 hotspot coordinates. Non-synonymous variants in these regions will be included in the snpeffr report (snpeff/combined_cauris_refB11205_fks1.csv). [default: fks1_hs1=221637: 221663,fks1_hs2=223782: 223805,fks1_hs3=221805: 221807]

save_reference.title: save_reference
save_reference.description: Saves the reference genome/index files to the results folder [default: true]

save_alignment.title: save_alignment
save_alignment.description: Saves the reference alignment BAM files to the samples results folder [default: true]

rapidnj.title: rapidnj
rapidnj.description: Build a tree using the RapidNJ neighbour-joining algorithm [default: true]

fasttree.title: fasttree
fasttree.description: Build a tree using the FastTree approximate ML algorithm [default: true]

snpeff.title: snpeff
snpeff.description: Run snpEff on the final VCF file [default: false]

iqtree.title: iqtree
iqtree.description: Build a tree using the IQ-TREE maximum likelihood algorithm

raxmlng.title: raxmlng
raxmlng.description: Build a tree using the RAxML-NG ML algorithm

save_debug.title: save_debug
save_debug.description: Save debug information for the workflow run

skip_samples.title: skip_samples
skip_samples.description: A comma separated list of IDs to skip for variant calling and analysis

skip_combined_analysis.title: skip_combined_analysis
skip_combined_analysis.description: Skip combined variant analysis (run reference prep and mapping)

coverage.title: coverage
coverage.description: Coverage is used to calculate a down-sampling rate that results in the specified coverage. For example, if coverage is 70, then FASTQ files are down-sampled such that, when aligned to the reference, the result is approximately 70x coverage [default: 0]

gvcfs_filter.title: gvcfs_filter
gvcfs_filter.description: Filter criteria for variants (GATK) [default: QD < 2.0 || FS > 60.0 || MQ < 40.0 || DP < 10]

max_amb_samples.title: max_amb_samples
max_amb_samples.description: Max number of samples with ambiguous calls for inclusion (GATK) [default: 10000000]

max_perc_amb_samples.title: max_perc_amb_samples
max_perc_amb_samples.description: Max percent of samples with ambiguous calls for inclusion (GATK) [default: 10]

min_depth.title: min_depth
min_depth.description: Min depth for a base to be called as the consensus sequence, otherwise it will be called as an N. Set to 0 to disable. [default: 10]

mask.title: mask
mask.description: Perform masking of reference genome before analysis [default: true]
